definitions.name: ENV III

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SHT30 uses 16-bit commands and six-byte T/RH responses with CRC8 per 16-bit word (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). QMP6988 requires chip identity, 25-byte calibration, configuration, status and compensated 24-bit pressure/temperature samples. ENVUnit pressure API returns hPa; the injected pressure-pa state uses Pa.

registers.warning: Current driver comment mentions 0x2C06 but executable MEASURE_CMD is 0x2C10.

registers.samples: 0xF7, pressure[3] then temperature[3], each unsigned 24-bit minus 2^23

gaps: QMP6988 raw bytes must be consistent with calibration and compensation; do not substitute host-calculated API values.
Fixture humidity permits the protocol range 0..100%RH; product accuracy specification is 10..90%RH.

definitions.name: ENV III

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SHT30 uses 16-bit commands and six-byte T/RH responses with CRC8 per 16-bit word (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). QMP6988 requires chip identity, 25-byte calibration, configuration, status and compensated 24-bit pressure/temperature samples. ENVUnit pressure API returns hPa; the injected pressure-pa state uses Pa.

registers.warning: Current driver comment mentions 0x2C06 but executable MEASURE_CMD is 0x2C10.

registers.samples: 0xF7, pressure[3] then temperature[3], each unsigned 24-bit minus 2^23

gaps: QMP6988 raw bytes must be consistent with calibration and compensation; do not substitute host-calculated API values.
Fixture humidity permits the protocol range 0..100%RH; product accuracy specification is 10..90%RH.

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: ENV III

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SHT30 uses 16-bit commands and six-byte T/RH responses with CRC8 per 16-bit word (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). QMP6988 requires chip identity, 25-byte calibration, configuration, status and compensated 24-bit pressure/temperature samples. ENVUnit pressure API returns hPa; the injected pressure-pa state uses Pa.

registers.warning: Current driver comment mentions 0x2C06 but executable MEASURE_CMD is 0x2C10.

registers.samples: 0xF7, pressure[3] then temperature[3], each unsigned 24-bit minus 2^23

gaps: QMP6988 raw bytes must be consistent with calibration and compensation; do not substitute host-calculated API values.
Fixture humidity permits the protocol range 0..100%RH; product accuracy specification is 10..90%RH.

definitions.name: RS485

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: TTL/UART to differential RS485 transceiver. Official driver sends host UART TX over yellow and receives on white (UIFlow tuple white,yellow); default init helper is 9600 8N1. Unit protocol bytes depend on the connected peer; no generic fixed Modbus address is implied.
gaps: Product lists external DC12V input and red wire 5V; exact power direction/regulation and automatic direction-control timing need schematic confirmation.
Electrical differential voltage, bus termination and collision behavior are not inferred from UART bytes.

definitions.name: ENV III

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SHT30 uses 16-bit commands and six-byte T/RH responses with CRC8 per 16-bit word (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). QMP6988 requires chip identity, 25-byte calibration, configuration, status and compensated 24-bit pressure/temperature samples. ENVUnit pressure API returns hPa; the injected pressure-pa state uses Pa.

registers.warning: Current driver comment mentions 0x2C06 but executable MEASURE_CMD is 0x2C10.

registers.samples: 0xF7, pressure[3] then temperature[3], each unsigned 24-bit minus 2^23

gaps: QMP6988 raw bytes must be consistent with calibration and compensation; do not substitute host-calculated API values.
Fixture humidity permits the protocol range 0..100%RH; product accuracy specification is 10..90%RH.

definitions.name: Thermal

definitions.name: ENV III

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SHT30 uses 16-bit commands and six-byte T/RH responses with CRC8 per 16-bit word (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). QMP6988 requires chip identity, 25-byte calibration, configuration, status and compensated 24-bit pressure/temperature samples. ENVUnit pressure API returns hPa; the injected pressure-pa state uses Pa.

registers.warning: Current driver comment mentions 0x2C06 but executable MEASURE_CMD is 0x2C10.

registers.samples: 0xF7, pressure[3] then temperature[3], each unsigned 24-bit minus 2^23

gaps: QMP6988 raw bytes must be consistent with calibration and compensation; do not substitute host-calculated API values.
Fixture humidity permits the protocol range 0..100%RH; product accuracy specification is 10..90%RH.

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: ENV III

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SHT30 uses 16-bit commands and six-byte T/RH responses with CRC8 per 16-bit word (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). QMP6988 requires chip identity, 25-byte calibration, configuration, status and compensated 24-bit pressure/temperature samples. ENVUnit pressure API returns hPa; the injected pressure-pa state uses Pa.

registers.warning: Current driver comment mentions 0x2C06 but executable MEASURE_CMD is 0x2C10.

registers.samples: 0xF7, pressure[3] then temperature[3], each unsigned 24-bit minus 2^23

gaps: QMP6988 raw bytes must be consistent with calibration and compensation; do not substitute host-calculated API values.
Fixture humidity permits the protocol range 0..100%RH; product accuracy specification is 10..90%RH.

definitions.name: RS485

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: TTL/UART to differential RS485 transceiver. Official driver sends host UART TX over yellow and receives on white (UIFlow tuple white,yellow); default init helper is 9600 8N1. Unit protocol bytes depend on the connected peer; no generic fixed Modbus address is implied.
gaps: Product lists external DC12V input and red wire 5V; exact power direction/regulation and automatic direction-control timing need schematic confirmation.
Electrical differential voltage, bus termination and collision behavior are not inferred from UART bytes.

definitions.name: ENV III

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SHT30 uses 16-bit commands and six-byte T/RH responses with CRC8 per 16-bit word (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). QMP6988 requires chip identity, 25-byte calibration, configuration, status and compensated 24-bit pressure/temperature samples. ENVUnit pressure API returns hPa; the injected pressure-pa state uses Pa.

registers.warning: Current driver comment mentions 0x2C06 but executable MEASURE_CMD is 0x2C10.

registers.samples: 0xF7, pressure[3] then temperature[3], each unsigned 24-bit minus 2^23

gaps: QMP6988 raw bytes must be consistent with calibration and compensation; do not substitute host-calculated API values.
Fixture humidity permits the protocol range 0..100%RH; product accuracy specification is 10..90%RH.

definitions.name: Thermal

definitions.name: ENV III

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SHT30 uses 16-bit commands and six-byte T/RH responses with CRC8 per 16-bit word (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). QMP6988 requires chip identity, 25-byte calibration, configuration, status and compensated 24-bit pressure/temperature samples. ENVUnit pressure API returns hPa; the injected pressure-pa state uses Pa.

registers.warning: Current driver comment mentions 0x2C06 but executable MEASURE_CMD is 0x2C10.

registers.samples: 0xF7, pressure[3] then temperature[3], each unsigned 24-bit minus 2^23

gaps: QMP6988 raw bytes must be consistent with calibration and compensation; do not substitute host-calculated API values.
Fixture humidity permits the protocol range 0..100%RH; product accuracy specification is 10..90%RH.

protocol.summary: CardKB v1.1 uses I2C address 0x5F and a key-code byte stream. Product documents 50 keys, shift/sym/fn transformations and one status RGB LED. The current shared driver also supports newer report-mode devices; that v2 path is not inherited by this v1.1 product.

registers.legacy_v1_1: readfrom(0x5F,1): 0 means no key; nonzero is a key code

gaps: Keyboard matrix, modifier-lock behavior and consume-on-read/empty semantics require matching v1.1 firmware evidence; do not inherit new CardKB v2 report registers.

definitions.name: ENV III

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SHT30 uses 16-bit commands and six-byte T/RH responses with CRC8 per 16-bit word (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). QMP6988 requires chip identity, 25-byte calibration, configuration, status and compensated 24-bit pressure/temperature samples. ENVUnit pressure API returns hPa; the injected pressure-pa state uses Pa.

registers.warning: Current driver comment mentions 0x2C06 but executable MEASURE_CMD is 0x2C10.

registers.samples: 0xF7, pressure[3] then temperature[3], each unsigned 24-bit minus 2^23

gaps: QMP6988 raw bytes must be consistent with calibration and compensation; do not substitute host-calculated API values.
Fixture humidity permits the protocol range 0..100%RH; product accuracy specification is 10..90%RH.

definitions.name: RS485

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: TTL/UART to differential RS485 transceiver. Official driver sends host UART TX over yellow and receives on white (UIFlow tuple white,yellow); default init helper is 9600 8N1. Unit protocol bytes depend on the connected peer; no generic fixed Modbus address is implied.
gaps: Product lists external DC12V input and red wire 5V; exact power direction/regulation and automatic direction-control timing need schematic confirmation.
Electrical differential voltage, bus termination and collision behavior are not inferred from UART bytes.

definitions.name: ENV III

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SHT30 uses 16-bit commands and six-byte T/RH responses with CRC8 per 16-bit word (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). QMP6988 requires chip identity, 25-byte calibration, configuration, status and compensated 24-bit pressure/temperature samples. ENVUnit pressure API returns hPa; the injected pressure-pa state uses Pa.

registers.warning: Current driver comment mentions 0x2C06 but executable MEASURE_CMD is 0x2C10.

registers.samples: 0xF7, pressure[3] then temperature[3], each unsigned 24-bit minus 2^23

gaps: QMP6988 raw bytes must be consistent with calibration and compensation; do not substitute host-calculated API values.
Fixture humidity permits the protocol range 0..100%RH; product accuracy specification is 10..90%RH.

definitions.name: Thermal

definitions.name: ENV III

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: SHT30 uses 16-bit commands and six-byte T/RH responses with CRC8 per 16-bit word (poly 0x31, init 0xFF). QMP6988 requires chip identity, 25-byte calibration, configuration, status and compensated 24-bit pressure/temperature samples. ENVUnit pressure API returns hPa; the injected pressure-pa state uses Pa.

registers.warning: Current driver comment mentions 0x2C06 but executable MEASURE_CMD is 0x2C10.

registers.samples: 0xF7, pressure[3] then temperature[3], each unsigned 24-bit minus 2^23

gaps: QMP6988 raw bytes must be consistent with calibration and compensation; do not substitute host-calculated API values.
Fixture humidity permits the protocol range 0..100%RH; product accuracy specification is 10..90%RH.
